cultural.vision_reason: This is a classic carved wooden face mask with scarification, painted brows, and raffia beard/fringe, consistent with Pende mask-making traditions (e.g., mbuya-type masks) of the DRC. The style, materials, and construction match Pende ritual masking practice well.

physical.title: mask
physical.summary: A carved wooden mask with cloth and fibre covering arched structure sewn through attachment holes; black fibre sewn through cloth densely resembling hair; a fringe of knotted bundles of coarse brown fibre attached through lower holes; mouth represented by raised grey ridges with white between; nose prominent deep flaring nostrils painted grey beneath; eyes with prominent upper lid and groove with grey and white paint beneath surmounted by grey double arched ridge brows; projecting rectangular white ears with overlaid central grey; oval grey scarification on cheeks and four vertical lines in central forehead; the main face colour is sandy yellow.
